about.title: Technical Partner for Digital and Telecommunication Infrastructure
about.description: CV Jerco Digital Solusi provides IT consulting, network infrastructure, fiber optic/OSP, CCTV, cloud/VPS, dashboard system, data analytics, technical documentation, BOQ/RAB preparation, KMZ/KML route analysis, permit support, and project coordination services.
points: Supporting clients from survey, planning, execution, to technical documentation.
Focused on technical accuracy, fast coordination, and project-ready deliverables.
Suitable for B2B clients, hotels, offices, ISPs, contractors, and government-related projects.
